messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — EduLabs prod org just onboarded an internal 'Assessment Authoring' team. Usage spiked ~6x in last 24h. Mostly short-gen + embeddings. Might convert to Dedicated soon.

ravi_am: Thanks for flagging. Do we have hard numbers on tokens/embeds? also renewal in ~3 months so this could be an expansion/opportunity.

aj_soleng: I can pull metrics now. which project ids should I look at? If they're doing OCR -> embeddings + rerank that explains the pattern.

maria_cs: Project IDs: edulabs-prod, edulabs-assess. Quick snapshot from our dashboard: tokens/day climbed from ~180k to ~1.1M; embedding calls x5; 99p latency nudged up from 420ms -> 610ms but p50/p95 still fine.

aj_soleng: That delta is pushing hosted limits for predictable tails. Recommend a trial Dedicated pod (4x pool) or reserved burst for grading windows. I'll draft config + throughput estimate.

ravi_am: OK — this is both risk (if latency degrades) and opportunity. We should prepare pricing scenarios. cc @julia_pdm for pricing + enablement slide deck.

julia_pdm: On it. I'll build a comparison: hosted overage vs 3-month and 6-month reserved capacity. Need their top-10 prompt/seq length distribution to model unit cost.

maria_cs: They told us the new use case: automated grading (per-exam) + OCR ingestion. So lots of embeddings, chunking, and reranking. Context windows longer for answer consolidation.

aj_soleng: For OCR+embeds I suggest batching + prefix/KV caching and a fallback to a smaller reranker during peak. Draft of suggested runtime config:
```
batching: {
  max_batch_tokens: 8192,
  max_latency_ms: 25
}
caching: {
  prefix_kv_cache: true,
  cache_ttl_ms: 300000
}
model_fallback: {
  primary: "open-redwood-xl",
  fallback: "open-redwood-large"
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary routing created for edulabs-assess -> eu-west-1 (meta) :gear:

ravi_am: Next steps: Aj to send perf + capacity proposal by EOD Wed; Julia to prepare pricing scenarios; Maria to schedule an enablement walkthrough with EduLabs infra + ML.

maria_cs: Booked enablement for 2026-03-31 10:00 PT — invite sent to their infra + data science leads. Also capturing feedback: their lead said "we need deterministic latency for grading runs" — logging as a priority requirement.

aj_soleng: I'll include SLO options (p99 latency caps, queue thresholds) and a recommended canary rollout plan with automatic fallback to smaller model variants if queue depth spikes.

julia_pdm: If they commit, recommend 6-month reserved with onboarding credits and 15% committed discount. I'll put two alternatives (3mo & 6mo) in the deck.

maria_cs: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update the account health doc (linking to the invite and Aj's config) and send a 1-pager summary to the CSM+rev teams after Aj's proposal is in.
